asset.name: DashboardGenerator
asset.description: Produces a dashboard from metric, chart, table, filter, layout, and refresh definitions while preserving loading, partial-failure, and responsive behavior.

requires.reason: Generated dashboard content mounts under the host AppShell; the generator does not redraw application chrome.
Compose responsive metric, chart and table regions using shared layout.
Render metric and chart surfaces with consumer-restylable cards.
